fact: In August 2022 the Mairie de Bujumbura ran a door-to-door verification campaign (18 July to 31 December 2022) partly to build a database of taxpayers and taxable matter, and the anti-corruption observatory OLUCOME called the Mairie's work manual.
title: Mairie de Bujumbura : Vers la constitution d'une base des données des contribuables et de la matière imposable
